messages:
alex_support: FYI ZephyrPay is getting persistent 429s starting ~09:12 UTC. Customer says no traffic spike on their side. Logs attached below, looks like a tight cluster at minute boundaries.

sarah_sre: Can you paste sample request logs (request_id, x-client-id, timestamp) and any x-ratelimit headers?

alex_support: here's a trimmed tail from our edge logs (request_id, client_id, ts):
```
req_01ab23  client: zp-main  ts: 2026-02-18T09:12:00.002Z
req_01ab24  client: zp-main  ts: 2026-02-18T09:12:00.003Z
req_01ab25  client: zp-main  ts: 2026-02-18T09:12:00.004Z
req_01ab26  client: zp-main  ts: 2026-02-18T09:12:00.005Z
req_01ab27  client: zp-main  ts: 2026-02-18T09:12:00.006Z
... many within same 100ms window ...
```

danielle_ops: That pattern screams minute-aligned burst. Could be a cron/job that fires at 09:12:00 exactly across many hosts or HTTP/2 multiplexing collapsing many streams. Also check if they rotate api keys which would bypass per-key smoothing.

tim_prod: Reminder: our enforcement is per-api-key RPM and a soft per-tenant aggregate. If a customer opens many persistent HTTP/2 streams or a proxy multiplexes, backend sees a burst. Any chance their SDK opens new connections each run?

alex_support: I reproduced locally with curl flood to simulate 60 reqs in 1s, this is what we see from the service: 
```
# repro (do not run against prod)
for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -D- -o /dev/null -H 'Authorization: Bearer testkey' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done; wait
# sample response headers when throttled
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 13
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Request-ID: r_028f
```

sarah_sre: Good repro. Proposed mitigation to suggest to client: 1) jitter their cron across 0-59s, 2) add small client-side backoff (jitter exponential), 3) aggregate/pool requests to reduce per-minute bursts. We should also show them how to read X-RateLimit headers.

danielle_ops: Also we can offer a short-lived soft bump (temporary RPM increase) while they roll a fix. Ops: any objections to +2x for 15m for tenant zp-main? :thinking_face:

oncall-bot: Incident patch applied: temporary quota bump 2x for tenant zp-main (id: bump-5201), expires in 15 minutes. Audit: ops@redwood.ai

tim_prod: One more operational ask: check our edge proxy settings for HTTP/2 concurrent stream limits. If proxy sends many concurrent streams to runtime, it worsens backend burstiness — consider limiting concurrent streams per connection.

alex_support: Customer plan: 1) spread cron trigger across minute window, 2) add client jitter 0-6s, 3) enable connection reuse instead of new short-lived connections. I'll send step-by-step guidance and monitor.

sarah_sre: Thanks — collect samples after they deploy change and reopen if 429s persist. :thumbsup:
